name: relayab
description: Self-hosted AI API relay: proxies OpenAI / Anthropic requests with per-key quota, expiry and usage accounting. Data lives in a local SQLite file — no external database service required.

RELAY_AUTH.description: Master secret: admin login password, session key and upstream-key encryption seed. Losing it makes every stored upstream key undecryptable.

NODE_ENV.description: Must be production. Leaving it unset puts the app on the in-memory store and every record is lost on restart.

RELAY_DB_PATH.description: Path to the SQLite file. Defaults to ./data/relayab.db inside the app directory; set it to keep the database outside the release so a rebuild cannot touch it.

RELAY_DEFAULT_LOCALE.description: Default UI locale: zh-CN or en.
